ideas.revisit_when: Explicit product decision after walk-forward evidence that a momentum grace rule beats trailing stops and screen-only exits on cost-adjusted excess return

ideas.title: Do not route automated paper-auto or decision-review through LLMs

ideas.revisit_when: Never for live automation; only reconsider if building a separate experimental LLM paper track with its own control datum

ideas.title: Keep exit-shadow cohort observe-only until maturity

ideas.title: Do not nudge decision-review portfolio knobs below history floor

ideas.revisit_when: Each paper track (ai_judgment, rules, momentum_grace) crosses the floor independently; then enable per-track knob review in decision-review

ideas.title: Bootstrap shadow sims from full-period knob retrospective
ideas.summary: Separate from the live learning loop: search the monitoring window for portfolio-knob groups that would have worked up to now (catch enough top buy-tier performers, exclude enough poor ones for excess vs ^FTSE). Seed those as competing observe-only shadow sims; the real test is whether they endure forward. Survivors become a starting prior for learning-loop refinement (not an auto-apply into live knobs). Complements L111/calibration; keeps N3 screen thresholds frozen.
ideas.revisit_when: Ready to run once rebalance logs ≥~12 acted/track or archives thicken (L111 milestone); promote only after forward shadow marks beat market and rules control

ideas.title: Do not search assign_signal thresholds for historical edge
ideas.summary: Retrospective tuning of frozen screen filters (composites, pass rates, quality floors) to catch winners over the monitoring period would look like edge today but conflicts with N3 and stage-5 counterfactual safety; keep such work research-only offline_sim if ever run, never auto-write into assign_signal.
ideas.revisit_when: Explicit product decision to override N3 / frozen-signal regime for a controlled research experiment

ideas.title: Stage-4 live universe expansion before 2b edge

ideas.title: Weekly consistency report for bootstrap shadow candidates
ideas.summary: Observe-only: step competing bootstrap knob groups through chronological weekly slices (log and later archive) and report week-on-week stability of excess/hit-rate — surface alongside fold_stability, do not re-rank solely on in-sample consistency or auto-cull shadows.
ideas.revisit_when: After bootstrap shadows have published endurance marks and L111 archive replay can supply weekly screen passes

ideas.title: Do not use weekly historical shadow rewind as promotion proof
ideas.summary: Rewinding competing shadows through known history to pick a winner overfits the same window used for bootstrap; keep weekly consistency as a diagnostic, and reserve promotion for forward endurance vs market/rules.
ideas.revisit_when: Only if a held-out weekly archive path (true walk-forward / purged CV) is implemented under L111

ideas.title: Held-out / purged walk-forward for bootstrap promotion
ideas.summary: Strengthen winner selection by requiring bootstrap priors to clear a held-out chronological slice (or purged CV) before shadow spawn counts as promotion-ready, reducing in-sample double-dip between full-period rank and historical consistency.
ideas.revisit_when: Acted logs ≥~20 per track or L111 weekly archives cover ≥12 months

ideas.title: Shadow GC and max concurrent calibrated books
ideas.summary: Cap competing calibrated shadows (e.g. top-3) and retire failed/stale ranks so weekday paper-auto and the dashboard stay readable as bootstrap refreshes each Sunday.
ideas.revisit_when: More than 3 calibrated shadow dirs exist in production or Sunday spawn starts stacking ranks

ideas.title: Do not auto-promote surviving shadows into ai_judgment
ideas.summary: Keep human gate between endurance survivors and primary config; auto-promotion would couple lab noise to live epochs before history is thick enough.
ideas.revisit_when: Multiple shadows have multi-month surviving status and primary still beats rules+market with human-seeded priors

ideas.title: Depth-first single-market FTSE-parity before parallel learning shards
ideas.summary: Stop treating multi-market Phase 1/2 promotion (AI beat rules on thin memos) as the path to equivalent learning. Instead sequentially deepen one small market to FTSE-like filings+memo+weekday cadence, then clone the weekly development system as an isolated parallel universe. Keep Layer A maintenance on other markets cheap; do not round-robin weekly_ops research across 21 thin shards.
ideas.revisit_when: FTSE stage 2b still primary OR eng capacity free; pick pilot market (prefer euro_stoxx50 or iseq20 over sp500) with a market-aware filing provider ready; weekly_ops can fund buy-tier depth for that one slice

ideas.title: Rewire shard promotion gates off AI-beat-rules until filing parity
ideas.summary: Current Phase 1→2 gate requires AI judgment to beat screen rules on observe sim, which is often unachievable or meaningless when memos lack filing bodies. Until a depth-first pilot has FTSE-comparable research inputs, gate Phase 2 on archives+metrics stability only (or screen-rules experiments), and reserve AI-track promotion for post-parity weekday shards.
ideas.revisit_when: Depth-first pilot doctrine accepted, or sp500 remains blocked on AI-beat-rules while euro_stoxx50 Phase 2 stalls on thin overlay

ideas.title: EU depth-first pilot as composite ~150-250 names not 21 thin shards
ideas.summary: For the first non-UK FTSE-parity build, group smaller European index slices into one isolated universe sized near the live FTSE screen (~150-250 unique names; buy-tier depth ~30-70). Prefer euro_stoxx50 alone as filing-stack proof, then expand with low-overlap periphery (ISEQ/OMXS/ATX/BEL/AEX/SMI/PSI) rather than stacking DAX+CAC+MIB (heavy STOXX overlap). One book needs one benchmark; keep US/APAC out of this pilot.
ideas.revisit_when: Depth-first doctrine (N37) accepted and euro_filings provider is being chosen for the first parallel universe

ideas.title: Spawn-aligned zero datum for calibrated shadow endurance
ideas.summary: Endurance survivor gates should key off excess since shadow spawn/fund reset (true OOS), not lifetime from first equity mark. Keep first-snapshot/lifetime market-beat as diagnostic context only — backdating the zero datum lengthens the series without adding OOS information and double-counts the bootstrap window that selected the prior.
ideas.revisit_when: Next endurance/calibration hardening pass, or when a shadow approaches survivor with thin post-spawn marks

ideas.title: Test wider paper books (4–5 max_positions) as shadow/lab, not live default
ideas.summary: Live tracks sit at max_positions=3 after cost-drag clamping; that is enough for sleeve mechanics but too concentrated for stable excess learning. Prefer a competing shadow or calibration grid cell at 4–5 before widening the primary book, given ~3% round-trip costs.
ideas.revisit_when: After spawn-aligned endurance zero datum lands, or when primary cost_drag falls and decision-review proposes max_positions up

ideas.title: Low-turnover broad shortlist shadow (not naive 20-name weekly churn)
ideas.summary: A diversified top-N book can reduce concentration noise vs 3-name sleeves, but with 3% per-side costs a naive 20-name equal-weight weekly rebalance will likely lose to the market on costs alone. If tested, use strong churn controls (replace-on-exit only, exit confirm, reentry cooldown) and treat it as a lab/diagnostic shadow — possibly with a lower paper cost assumption — rather than widening the primary learning book.
ideas.revisit_when: After 4–5 position competing shadow exists, or when designing a diversification diagnostic track
ideas.source: discussion: would 20 best picks beat the market

ideas.title: PIT warm-start shadow seed then forward-only endurance
ideas.summary: Allow calibrated/lab shadows to be populated via archive/rebalance replay from a chosen sim start with per-name entry marks, then freeze a zero datum at seed end so endurance/promotion uses only post-seed forward marks. Must be PIT (no target list chosen with future info) and must not mix backdated P&L into survivor gates.

ideas.title: Endurance hysteresis grace (not seed-advantage cushion)

Pass all inputs via env: + allowlists; never ${{ }} into script bodies. Implemented in PR #384 (env: + allowlists + dispatch_input_in_run scanner).

ideas.title: Lot-link DCA entry blocks to tactical sells
ideas.summary: Do not pair individual DCA tranches with tactical take-profits to 'average down' remaining cost. Paper avg_cost is weighted-average (a skim realizes P&L, it does not lower remaining basis). A sell+rebuy clip must clear Suite A 6% round-trip or fair UK ~0.55% including stamp. ideas.title: Pyramid add-on while still held beyond original sleeve
ideas.summary: A second buy trigger on a name still at/near full sleeve (pyramiding) is a different decision from recommit-after-exit. Do not allow adds above the original target until first-entry cadence is ranked and conviction-weighted sizing exists. Observe recommit-after-exit separately so it does not contaminate DCA evidence.
ideas.revisit_when: entry_dca_overlay ready_for_cadence_analysis on first_entry AND conviction_weighted_sizing is active

ideas.title: Parked-but-fed experiment state with lineage
ideas.summary: Add parked/retired/child states to experiment assessment. Winners spawn a same-stage child; losers leave the complexity budget but keep weekday marks until max_trade_lifecycle_days (84d min, 400d default), then retire. Do not map fail to cancelled for lifecycle overlays. No auto-apply.

ideas.summary: rebalance_log, entry_dca overlay episodes, and exit-timing cohorts grow without the dense-400d then monthly then quarterly policy. When they bloat, thin marks the same way as library PIT history; keep rollup summaries. Do not hard-delete at 3 years like committed FTSE weekly history.

ideas.summary: Early discretionary cap is 12 tasks / 8 expensive shadows so every lifecycle stage can stay covered. After experiment_lineage_and_park can park losers without cancelling their cheap feed, consider tightening discretionary tasks toward 8 if agent triage is noisy — never put coverage overlays back under the cap.

ideas.summary: Live inventory is 1 open task / 4 shadows against the generous 12/8 soft budget. Raising the cap further would not add coverage (lifecycle stages are already perpetual) and would weaken the agent-triage signal. Keep 12/8 until Sunday open tasks repeatedly hit the 75% warn.
ideas.revisit_when: experiment_inventory.complexity.warn_discretionary_tasks is true on 3 consecutive Sunday director runs

Value downgrade vs rising price: rotate on screen downgrade vs ride recognition-phase momentum while the name is no longer cheap — core tension for exit overlays, not stock picking.
Bounded momentum grace may cut winner churn but risks style drift — holding non-cheap names when the trend breaks.
Post-close regret is ambiguous: price rising after exit does not prove a wrong sell — exit-shadow learning needs risk-adjusted and opportunity-cost framing.
Browser localStorage paper funds and server paper_automation tracks are different books — same strategy names, different canonical sources for decision-review.
Daily weekday paper-auto surveillance vs weekly decision-review knob learning — UI 'self-improving' narrative overshoots actual adaptation cadence.
Archive ftse-simulate, browser paper_sims, and server learning tracks coexist without one anchor for which automated model is under evaluation.
Stage 2b primary track still negative excess after costs while ops/library infra ran ahead — when does doctrine pause breadth until AI excess turns positive?
Ingest canonical bootstrap increases counted zero-body buy-tier stalls before depth pays off — stall metrics may need a third state beyond pass/fail.
Sunday screen refresh vs Mon/Wed/Fri capped ingest — buy-tier memo depth may need a guaranteed post-Sunday ingest pass at full cap.
Ops micro-compile can false-green ingest stalls when the engineering queue is empty and zero-body count unchanged — targeted escalation policy still open.

Recurring observe sim beats one-shot passes but thin run_count is infrastructure not signal — run_count/archive gate for experiment promotion undefined.
Compile/dispatch races and analysis-review on pre-merge screens can desync dashboard conclusions from merged code — loop-level artifact freshness checks may be needed.
Auto-merge is scoped to narrow CI-fix tasks; ingest/scoring engineering PRs stay human-merge — implicit throughput ceiling on self-improvement.
Research spend scales with researched-name count R not universe N — widen or raise buy-tier memo caps need a hard weekly research_cap or ingest/API cost dominates.
